product.name: Highlander Men's Slim Fit Casual Checkered Shirt
product.description: A slim-fit men's casual checkered shirt with long sleeves, spread collar and button closure. Designed for casual outings, weekends, brunch and smart-casual office wear. The shirt is positioned as lightweight, breathable and suitable for everyday use.

buying_advice.size_advice: The source lists S, M, L and XL. Reviews are mixed on fit: several customers report good fitting, while others report imperfect or loose fitting. Shopi should recommend checking the size chart rather than assuming the normal size will fit.
buying_advice.fabric_advice: Do not present the fabric as definitively 100% cotton. The product highlights say 100% cotton, while the description says poly cotton and a customer reports nylon-mixed fabric.
buying_advice.quality_advice: This product has stronger review evidence than SHIRT-009. It can reasonably be positioned as a good-value everyday shirt, but not as a premium fabric product.
buying_advice.occasion_advice: Prioritize casual, everyday, weekend, brunch and smart-casual office recommendations.
buying_advice.summer_advice: The listing explicitly positions it for summer and describes the fabric as breathable/lightweight, so summer matching is reasonable. However, avoid making strong performance claims because customer reports on fabric are mixed.
buying_advice.price_advice: Use the actual live catalog price rather than hard-coding ₹450. The source contains multiple prices depending on variant/offer.

recommended: Tumble dry on low or air dry

source_inconsistencies: The listing calls the product a casual striped shirt in one description section, while the structured product data identifies the pattern as Checkered.
